name: Spirit Walker (Koropokkuru Variant)
body:
Some koropokkuru feel a connection to the spirits that goes beyond the ordinary. They are called “spirit walkers” by their kin, and are said to have one foot in the mortal world and one foot in the realm of the supernatural.

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Wis, +2 Cha, –2 Dex. This trait alters ability scores.
Spirit Diplomacy You get along well with fey and nature spirits. You gain a +2 species bonus on Diplomacy checks made with creatures of the fey type or the kami subtype. This trait replaces defensive training.
Spirit Magic You can use beguiling gift and echo once each per day as spell-like abilities, using your character level as the caster level and Charisma as your casting ability. This trait replaces lucky.
Spirit Sight (Su) Your special connection to the spirit world allows you to see ethereal creatures as easily as you see material creatures and objects. You can easily distinguish between ethereal creatures and material ones, because ethereal creatures appear translucent and indistinct. This trait replaces hatred.
Alternate Species Traits
Cave Dweller Rather than defend their homelands against oni invaders, some koropokkuru fled to live in deep caverns for safety and remain there to this day. You gain darkvision to 60 feet. This trait replaces defensive training and low-light vision.
Dwarf You can select any dwarf species trait that replaces either the hardy or the hatred species trait, or both. This trait replaces hardy and/or hatred.
Wanderer Some koropokkuru are stricken with wanderlust. These koropokkuru are often considered unruly vagabonds by their kin but excel at the rigors of traveling. You gain Endurance as a bonus feat, as well as a +2 species bonus on Diplomacy and Knowledge (geography) checks. This trait replaces lucky and skilled.
Favored Class Bonuses
Barbarian Add a +1/2 bonus to trap sense or +1/3 to the bonus from the superstitious rage power.
Druid Add +1/3 to your natural armor bonus when using wild shape.
Fighter Add +1 to your CMD when resisting a dirty trick or trip attempt.
Kineticist Gain a +1/2 bonus on Perception and Stealth skill checks against creatures with the elemental subtype matching your primary element.
Monk Add +1 to your CMD when resisting a grapple and +1/2 to the number of stunning attacks you can attempt per day.
Ranger Add +1 hit point to your animal companion. If you ever replace your animal companion, the new animal companion gains these bonus hit points.
Rogue Add +1/2 to sneak attack damage dealt to creatures with the goblinoid subtype or oni subtype.
Shaman Add +1/4 to the natural armor bonus of your spirit animal.
Witch Add +1 hit point to your familiar. If you ever replace your familiar, the new familiar gains these bonus hit points.

Awesome Ancestries: 9 New Fantasy Species. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
